# Chronology of brain

This appendix is the engineering timeline the book's historical threads are drawn from. It is generated from the repository's own history: for every month, the number of commits and the crates that first appeared (dated by their earliest name when they were later renamed, and linked to the chapters that explain them). Dates are author dates; the history is kept linear by rebasing, which preserves them.

The chapters teach in the order a reader needs the ideas. This page shows the order in which brain actually needed them, which is often very different: the engine began with a mixture-of-experts language model and a GPU kernel compiler, and only later grew the toy models a beginner would start with.
